title: Validate a prefixed identifier
note: ABC followed by exactly three digits. Ignore case also permits abc123.
rules:
start "ABC"
3 digits
end

title: Exclude characters
note: Empty strings are allowed. The recipe excludes a, b, c and d; Ignore case also excludes A, B, C and D.
rules:
start
text without: a, b, c, d
end

title: Read a line rule
note: Search mode finds a line ending with at least three digits; the prefix may include more digits. Entire string mode requires the match to cover the whole example.
rules:
line start
any text
3 digits
line end

title: Match a date shape
note: YYYY-MM-DD shape only. Impossible dates such as 2026-02-31 also match; validate calendar values separately.

title: Match a version shape
note: Three numeric parts with literal dots. Leading zeros are allowed, and prerelease suffixes are rejected. This is not full SemVer.
rules:
start
digits
"."
digits
"."
digits
end

title: Match a hex color
note: Six hex digits after #, in either letter case. Only #RRGGBB; no shorthand, alpha or other CSS color forms.
rules:
start "#"
6 hex digits
end

title: Match a MAC address shape
note: Six colon-separated pairs of ASCII hexadecimal digits. Shape only; check address allocation separately.
rules:
start
2 hex digits
":"
2 hex digits
":"
2 hex digits
":"
2 hex digits
":"
2 hex digits
":"
2 hex digits
end

title: Match a UUID shape
note: Five ASCII hexadecimal groups of 8–4–4–4–12 characters, in either letter case. Bare text only; no braces or urn:uuid: prefix. Shape only; check version, variant and uniqueness separately.
rules:
start
8 hex digits
"-"
4 hex digits
"-"
4 hex digits
"-"
4 hex digits
"-"
12 hex digits
end

title: Match a case-sensitive product-code shape
note: Two uppercase ASCII letters, three lowercase ASCII letters and four digits. JavaScript's i option ignores case; verify product records separately.
rules:
start
2 uppercase letters
"-"
3 lowercase letters
"-"
4 digits
end

title: Match an invoice ID shape
note: INV- followed by 2–6 ASCII digits. Leading zeros are allowed; verify invoice records separately.
rules:
start "INV-"
between 2 and 6 digits
end

title: Match a username shape
note: 3–16 ASCII word characters, starting with a letter; digits and underscores may follow. Check availability and service rules separately. Ignore case also permits Unicode case-folding equivalents.
rules:
start letter
between 2 and 15 word characters
end

title: Match a time shape
note: HH:MM shape only, using ASCII digits. Values such as 25:99 also match; validate hour and minute ranges separately.
rules:
start
2 digits
":"
2 digits
end

title: Match a phone-number shape
note: Optional + followed by 7–15 ASCII digits, without spaces or punctuation. Leading zeros are allowed. This is only a shape; check country rules and number validity separately.
rules:
start
optional "+"
between 7 and 15 digits
end

title: Match an IPv4 address shape
note: Four dot-separated groups of 1–3 ASCII digits. Values above 255 and leading zeros match too; validate octet ranges and network rules separately.
rules:
start
between 1 and 3 digits
"."
between 1 and 3 digits
"."
between 1 and 3 digits
"."
between 1 and 3 digits
end

title: Match a .txt filename shape
note: 1–64 Unicode code points before .txt, excluding slash, backslash, NUL and line breaks. Spaces, dots and other punctuation are allowed. This is only a shape; check filesystem rules and file existence separately.
rules:
start
between 1 and 64 path segment characters
".txt"
end

title: Read a complex artifact manifest
note: Synthetic TSV record: optional nightly/ directory, a 1–32 character project name, version, artifact filename, 64 hex digits and byte count. Checks shape only, not files, dates, versions or checksum contents.
rules:
start
"incoming/"
optional "nightly/"
between 1 and 32 path segment characters
"/v"
between 1 and 3 digits
"."
between 1 and 3 digits
"."
between 1 and 3 digits
"/linux-arm64/widget_"
8 digits
"_"
8 hex digits
".tar.gz\t"
64 hex digits
"\t"
between 1 and 12 digits
end

note: Synthetic access-log record: address, timestamp, quoted request, status, size, referer and user agent. Shape only; validate IP, calendar and HTTP values separately. Does not extract fields.
rules:

between 1 and 3 digits

between 1 and 3 digits

between 1 and 3 digits
" - "
between 1 and 32 none of: " ", "\n", "\r", "\u2028", "\u2029"

2 digits

4 digits

2 digits
":"
2 digits
" "
one of: "+", "-"
4 digits
"] \""
between 3 and 7 uppercase letters
" "
between 1 and 200 none of: " ", "\"", "\n", "\r", "\u2028", "\u2029"
" HTTP/"
digit
"."
digit
"\" "
3 digits
" "
between 1 and 10 digits
" \""
between 1 and 200 none of: "\"", "\n", "\r", "\u2028", "\u2029"
"\" \""
between 1 and 200 none of: "\"", "\n", "\r", "\u2028", "\u2029"
"\""
end

title: Match a lowercase slug
note: ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens; no leading, trailing or repeated hyphen. Ignore case broadens the letter set.
rules:
start
one or more character class: range "a" to "z", digit
zero or more group {
  "-"
  one or more character class: range "a" to "z", digit
}
end

title: Find a file extension
note: Searches for a case-sensitive txt, md or json suffix, including a bare extension. Does not validate the filename or filesystem.

title: Match a UTC timestamp shape
note: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS with optional 1–9 fractional digits and Z. Impossible dates and times can match; offsets and calendar validation are outside this recipe.
rules:
start
4 digits
"-"
2 digits
"-"
2 digits
"T"
2 digits
":"
2 digits
":"
2 digits
optional group {
  "."
  between 1 and 9 digits
}
"Z"
end

title: Match a simple HTTPS URL shape
note: A lowercase https scheme, ASCII hostname components and an optional slash path without whitespace. Not a standards-complete URL or DNS validator; no ports, userinfo or IPv6.

title: Extract a simple header field
note: One ASCII letter/hyphen field name, colon, one space and a nonempty single-line value. A small header fragment, not the complete HTTP field grammar or a message parser.

title: Match a Markdown heading fragment
note: One to six # characters, a space and a nonempty single-line heading. Does not parse Markdown block context, optional closing markers or escaping.
rules:
start
between 1 and 6 "#"
" "
capture "heading" {
  one or more none of: "\r", "\n", "\u2028", "\u2029"
}
end

title: Validate SemVer 2.0 syntax
note: Checks core numbers, prerelease identifiers and build metadata under SemVer 2.0. Numeric prerelease identifiers cannot have leading zeros; build identifiers can. Does not compare precedence or verify releases.

title: Match a Git object hash shape
note: Exactly 40 or 64 ASCII hexadecimal characters for SHA-1 or SHA-256 object-name shapes. Does not check the algorithm, repository object existence or abbreviated names.

title: Match two repeated words
note: Two identical case-sensitive ASCII letter sequences separated by one space. A backward named reference; not language-aware word segmentation or arbitrary duplicate detection.
rules:
start
capture "word" {
  letters
}
" "
same as capture "word"
end

title: Detect adjacent duplicate tokens
note: Two identical 1–16 ASCII word-character tokens separated by a comma. Checks one adjacent pair, not an entire list or non-adjacent duplicates.
rules:
start
capture "token" {
  between 1 and 16 word characters
}
","
same as capture "token"
end

title: Match Unicode letters and marks
note: A Unicode letter followed by letters or combining marks, including Arabic and Urdu. Uses native L/M properties; no normalization, grapheme counting or complete identifier validation.
rules:
start
unicode property "L"
zero or more character class: unicode property "L", unicode property "M"
end

title: Extract named fields from a log fragment
note: Searches for INFO, WARN or ERROR followed by code= and three ASCII digits. Extracts level and code; does not parse a complete log format or validate HTTP status semantics.

title: Search and replace a typo
note: Finds case-sensitive teh at native ASCII word boundaries. Displays every search match, but the non-global replacement changes only the first occurrence; enabling g changes the expectation.
